name: Holy Child Academy Summer Camp
description_short: Day camp at Holy Child Academy in Drexel Hill with half and full days. Little Dragons (ages 2 to 3) stay in the early childhood rooms; traditional campers (rising pre-K to 6th grade) move through PE, crafts, cooking, STEM and world cultures, with water play on campus or bus trips to a swim club twice a week.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds are generally not given; the camp refunds a week only if it can fill the spot.
swim_waterfront_notes: Little Dragons and rising pre-K to 1st grade have water play on campus twice a week (water slide, sprinkler, water tables). Rising 2nd graders and up ride a bus to Drexel Swim Club on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons, with lifeguards on duty.
notes: 2027 weekly rates: 3 half days $190, 4 half days $250, 5 half days $315; 3 full days $235, 4 full days $315, 5 full days $395. Half day 8:30 to 12:30, full day 8:30 to 4:30. Before care from 7:30 and after care 4:30 to 6:00 by coupon ($10 each or 10 for $90). Families pack snacks and lunch or buy lunch from the camp's lunch provider. Register week by week; groups go by 2027 to 2028 school year grade. A Junior CIT program serves rising 7th and 8th graders.

sessions.name: Summer 2027, nine weeks (register by the week; no camp July 5)
